messages.content: "請問您能否提供我過去30天內微軟和蘋果的以下財務數據？首先，我想知道微軟股票的平均收盤價，使用的資料來源是Yahoo Finance。其次，我需要知道蘋果的總收入，使用的資料來源是Google Finance。第三，我對微軟和蘋果的股票交易總量也感興趣，同樣使用的資料來源是Yahoo Finance。請您幫我計算這些數據好嗎？"

function.name: volume_traded
function.description: Calculate the total volume of stocks traded over a certain period of time Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: Name of the company to get data for

days.description: Number of past days to calculate volume traded for

data_source.description: Source to fetch the financial data. default is 'yahoo finance'

days.description: Number of past days to calculate average closing price for

message.reasoning: The user wants three calculations: avg_closing_price for Microsoft, total_revenue for Apple, and volume_traded for both companies. We need to call each function separately. The user explicitly requested Yahoo for avg_closing_price and Google for total_revenue. For volume_traded, they said "同樣使用的資料來源是Yahoo Finance" meaning use Yahoo. So we should call avg_closing_price with company=Microsoft, days=30, data_source=Yahoo Finance. Then total_revenue with company=Apple, days=30, data_source=Google Finance. Then volume_traded for Microsoft and Apple. But volume_traded expects company and days; we can call twice or combine? The function signature only accepts one company at a time. So we need two calls: one for Microsoft, one for Apple. The user didn't specify days for volume_traded but implied same period (past 30 days). So we use days=30. Also data_source=Yahoo Finance. So we need to call avg_closing_price, total_revenue, volume_traded for Microsoft, volume_traded for Apple. That’s four calls. The user wants all three data points. We can do them sequentially.
